notes.title: Emotional Support.
notes.content:
ːEnochː Hai, (Was thinking this today)

It was always the plan to have some kind of after support for those effected by some of the themes in Uriel's Chasm, even there*  "GAMEJOLTS AT THE GATES ARGGHHHH..MAN THE TURRETS!!" execution.

Up until now, members of the community (and random people from Texas!!) have been friending me and we've had some realy cool chats about the effect of some of the subliminal themes and what exactly this social experiment set out to do. As well as their sad histories with Christianity and/or interests in theology in general.

Its been amazing and completely abstract to meet you all through this "thing", Maybe not to the level of the tears in the final minutes of "Atari: gameover" (such a powerful moment for me)*, but well see in a few decades yeah ? 

One of the aims of this was to break the religious programming experienced by many American Christian "backsliders"  and re-introduce them to the Bible, not with spoon fed bumper sticker theology, but the truth..Not that sunday school "giraffe hanging out Noahs ark window" thing.

On the flip side, I casualy strolled into this sacred temple of gaming culture, held up the ten commandments of "basic game functionality" and smashed it to pieces. In a "fantasy" attempt to break another form of evolving religion/programming (complete with the public stoneing of women, "caught in the act of adultery"....with ***** guys). Judging people by their appearance/weight ! 

The games about multiple forms of religion..in case you havn't guessed.

Now I welcome all to add me , I'd love to meet and deliver on that promise of some kind of support. I am a Christian after all and I'd love to present to you the Jesus Christ of the Bible. ːtreeoflifeː

This was meant to be more than some random curio.. but be something rare, a concept that even something sad and broken like "Atari E.T." can change lives, have a soul behind it, create a community and despite absolutely brutal limitations (a bundle-generation Bible game with the power to destroy a small world.) Bleed out into reality, help people in a real way.


I hope to vastly elaborate on the power of programming with the minimally interactive spiritual sequel "Selfie:Sisters of the amniotic lens"


World peace! Love and dolphin kisses! ːhitcharideː

* Their ?? 
** Love how this thing that broke the gaming world and destroyed one mans dream inspired a film with such a beautiful climax/group hug. Watch it! 

***** thats 5

notes.title: Spiritual Sequel, so excited right now! (coming soon)
notes.content:
I'm so excited for what's happening next, I guess it is a sequel of sorts.

Many of the concepts introduced here will be coming through and will be expanded to the extreme.
 
With a bigger emphasis on allegorical story telling, quantum mechanic kinds of things, and non-stop "we missed you" moments.

It will be almost completely story driven, from 9 viewpoints this time, in a world the size of your imagination.

ALOT more Jarboe with a full official custom "mixtape".

Plus some FMV involvement from some of the amazing people I have met through the  U.C. giveaway Oh and its 3d........ like 1980's 3d!!!

All, I will say for now is, "gone home"  meets "no mans sky" on a "mirror moon " to the tune of  the 2001's space monolith

The extreme limitation we set for ourselves this time - 
" you have no arms, no legs, no chance to get out of a dirty road side motel room, now ....go make an epic space adventure"

notes.title: Tin foil hats and tinsel! its a RSG Christmas!
notes.content:
It's that special time of year again, the celebration of that one distinct hypostasis of God, born in poverty to save  his people from the oppression of the supernatural entity "Sin".

Emmanuel ("God with us")

Why not celebrate this festival of giving by gifting Uriel's chasm.
The game that celebrates 

NOT ONE...

NOT TWO...

BUT ALL THREE  hypostasis of God. *

Uriel's chasm was built from the ground up to be the gift your grandmother got you, that you were just stuck with. Many of these went on to hold the most nostalgia.

Be somebodies evil grandmother , TODAY!

A % of the money raised will go to an independent food bank serving those hit hardest by the recession; in the very community of the shovelware queens. (as is my growing custom)

Merry Christmas all and we cant wait to unleash the nightmarish world of  "Sisters of the amniotic lens" on you In the new year :D 

//RSG//


Ps. dont forget to claim your free albums of music by F.tyler 

http://ftyler.bandcamp.com/album/electronic-ambient-f-tyler-ptsd-vol-1-lp-2014




* We do not claim to represent every god, but the unknown God of Acts 17:23

"For as I passed along and observed the objects of your worship, I found also an altar with this inscription, ‘To the unknown god.’ What therefore you worship as unknown, this I proclaim to you"

notes.title: F.Tyler concept album
notes.content:
Rail Slave Games sympathizer F.Tyler has created a concept album based on  Uriel's Chasm, how cool is that ?? :D 

Take it away F.Tyler :-




First, my name is F. Tyler, and I'm an independent visual artist and musician from the Dallas, TX area. In regards to this album's creation, spirituality has always been the single most important drive in my life to do anything. From my art to my career, the spiritual drive has been the only thing to keep me going, thus far. Anything that views religion or the human soul in a new way is of paramount influence to my own work.
 After playing Uriel's Chasm, I was inspired to create this album. Being that the game could be considered iconoclastic and extremely metaphorical, much like any holy doctrine, was a huge part of the motivation behind this. I would like to extent a very special thank you to Rail Slave for allowing me to create the album and supporting its release, and thank you for listening. Please visit my website, www.ftyler.com, for other music and updates about other projects. I look forward to your thoughts, suggestions, and questions.

Here is the Album 

http://www.mediafire.com/download/c7wv9wkegiodm97/F._Tyler_-_PTSD_Vol._1_-_Uriels_Chasm.zip

 We are looking into making a limited physical CD/vinyl run.
